title: Design System: QSAI Copilot public site

display.purpose: The hero hook only, two lines, second line in Saudi Green; uppercase via --display-case.

headline.purpose: Every section h2; balanced wrap inside a 72ch section head.

title.purpose: Tag titles, form headings, bundle names; 1.05-1.15rem inside packed grids. Arabic line-height 1.5.

display-ar.purpose: html[lang=ar] override of display: Alexandria, no transform, 1.22 leading, 18ch max.

headline-ar.purpose: html[lang=ar] override of headline; h3 drops to clamp(1.3rem, 1.9vw, 1.6rem).

lead.purpose: Hero and dark-band paragraphs at 58-62ch; Arabic line-height 1.85.

body.purpose: Default copy at 300; 0.95rem inside tags, tables and lists; strong is 600.

mark.purpose: Stencilled identifier on a tag, bar or column (captions, discipline names, bar-mark IDs, table heads, ext badges). Uppercase +0.04em Latin; Arabic drops case and tracking. Never a kicker above a heading.

label.purpose: Form labels, nav links, chip and pill text (0.8-0.95rem).

caption.purpose: Hints, file codes, sheet lists, legal; ruler ticks at 0.7rem.

shadows.name: shadow-tag
shadows.purpose: Tag at rest: bundle tags, comparison frame, selected tabs, active stations, remnant tag.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on packed bundle and use-case cells, with translateY(-2px).

shadows.name: shadow-btn
shadows.purpose: Hairline under secondary buttons at rest; primary uses alpha 0.12.

shadows.name: shadow-btn-hover
shadows.purpose: Button hover with translateY(-1px); primary uses 0 10px 20px -10px rgba(0, 108, 53, 0.6).

shadows.name: shadow-bar
shadows.purpose: Underside of ribbed bar rules; hero stock bar uses 0 10px 18px -12px rgba(20, 38, 27, 0.5).

shadows.name: shadow-hole
shadows.purpose: The punched hole in a tag. The only inset in the system; it draws a hole, never a bevel.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every entrance, timeline step and hover transform.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Looping figure motion only (scroll cue, station scan, bob).

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 0.9s, transform 1s, filter 0.9s var(--ease-out); from opacity 0.001 translateY(22px) blur(4px)
motion.purpose: The single entrance style for [data-reveal]; added class .in by IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.08, rootMargin 0 0 -8% 0).

motion.name: hover-rise
motion.purpose: Hover always moves with the shadow step.

motion.name: timeline-cut
motion.value: steel scaleX 700ms; per mark: segment clip 520ms, label 420ms (+120), blade 300ms (+430), step 560ms; remnant 300ms + tag 420/520ms
motion.purpose: Hero cutting-stock Timeline (Web Animations API, paused, fill both); plays once at 30% visibility after 350ms; range input scrubs; reduced motion seeks to end.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): no transitions, end states shown, timelines seeked to duration, loops off

surfaces.name: pour-line-grid
surfaces.value: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(20,38,27,.045) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(20,38,27,.035) 1px, transparent 1px); 96px 96px; center top
surfaces.purpose: The concrete apron; on the dark band the lines are white at .04/.035.

surfaces.name: ribbed-steel
surfaces.purpose: Unpainted bar; 9px/2px on 10-30px bars, 5px/1px on 8-10px ends; 180deg for vertical spines.

surfaces.name: gold-tie
surfaces.value: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold-3), var(--gold-2)); 24px x 2px; rotate(-32deg) (32deg in RTL)
surfaces.purpose: The tie leaving a tag's punched hole.

narrative.overview:
The site is a rebar yard rendered as a page. The ground is a white concrete apron with faint pour lines (a 96px grid at 3.5–4.5% ink), and everything on it is either a bar, a tag, or a painted end. Horizontal ribbed steel rules carry the structure; their painted ends carry the one piece of meaning the brand owns: Saudi green for Measured, gold for Calculated, an unpainted dashed ghost for what is not yet quantified (the remnant offcut, items awaiting data). Labels, stats and the form live on white bundle tags that hang from a gold tie through a punched hole. The display face is condensed and stencil-born (Big Shoulders Display, uppercase, set almost solid at line-height 0.92); Arabic keeps the same density with Alexandria, unforced case, and taller leading. Body is a light-weight humanist shared by both scripts (Readex Pro 300).

Density is high but ordered: deliverables are packed edge to edge as tagged bundles with file codes and numbered sheet maps; comparison and feature content sits in gridded white tags separated by 1px seams rather than gaps. Depth is literal offset shadow only, two voices (tag at rest, lift on hover); nothing glows, nothing bevels. Motion runs on one clock: every entrance is the same 22px rise with a 4px blur settling under an exponential ease-out, and the hero's cutting-stock timeline is the signature interaction, scrubbable and replayed on view. The world rejects the hero-screenshot-plus-feature-grid landing and the dark "AI glow" page; the only dark material is a single deep-green painted band, used once per page.
keyCharacteristics: White concrete-apron ground with a faint 96px pour-line grid, never a flat colour
Ribbed steel bar rules with painted ends as the live colour code (green = Measured, gold = Calculated, ghost = not yet quantified)
White bundle tags with a punched hole and a gold tie carry every label, stat and form
Condensed uppercase stencil display (Latin) and Alexandria display (Arabic) over a 300-weight humanist body
Depth from soft offset shadows only; one dark painted band per page; one entrance motion; one shared timeline clock

rules.name: The Painted End Rule
rules.body: Colour means something or it is not applied. Green and gold appear as paint on the ends of steel, as status swatches, or on a control; never as decorative fills, gradients behind text, or tinted section backgrounds (the two washes are the only tints and they sit under table cells and chips).

rules.name: The One Dark Band Rule
rules.body: `green-deep` is used for exactly one band per page. It carries its own faint white pour-line grid and its tags switch to the on-dark variant; gold becomes the accent on it, not green.

rules.name: The Ghost Rule
rules.body: Absence is drawn, not hidden. Not-quantified and superseded states use a dashed Steel Light outline or an Apron fill, so a reader sees that something was deliberately left unpainted.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone. No eyebrow, kicker or overline sits above an `h2`; the section head is a headline and a sub, nothing else. The stencil Mark is reserved for identifiers placed on tags, bars and columns.

rules.name: The Script Parity Rule
rules.body: Arabic is set as its own display system (Alexandria, natural case, 1.22 leading, wider heading max-width in ch), not as a transformed copy of the Latin one. Any new display style must carry its `html[lang="ar"]` override before it ships.

rules.name: The Solid Block Rule
rules.body: Latin display and headline lines are set at 0.92 line-height with tracking -0.01em; never loosen them to look "airy". Lines are allowed to touch.

rules.name: The Daylight Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is ink-tinted (`rgba(20, 38, 27, …)`), offset downward, and negative-spread so it never halos. Hover adds a rise of 1–2px plus the next shadow up; nothing animates a shadow without also moving.

rules.name: The Hole, Not Bevel Rule
rules.body: Inset shadows draw holes (the tag's punched hole, the remnant tag's eyelet). They never draw pressed or embossed surfaces.

dos: **Do** keep the apron's pour-line grid under everything (96px, ink at 4.5% / 3.5%), and switch it to white at 4% on the dark band.
**Do** build any new rule, divider or progress track as the ribbed bar (Steel / Steel Light repeating gradient) with painted ends at the extremes, 3px corners.
**Do** put labels, stats and forms on a bundle tag (white, 1px Seam, 6px, Tag shadow, punched hole and gold tie) rather than inventing a new card.
**Do** carry Measured / Calculated / Not quantified as green / gold / red outline on the swatch, never on the chip body or text.
**Do** set Latin display uppercase at 0.92 line-height and -0.01em, and ship the `html[lang="ar"]` override (Alexandria, no transform, 1.22) with it.
**Do** use `[data-reveal]` with `--i` for entrances and a `Timeline` for any sequence; honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by showing end states.
**Do** keep hover as a 1–2px rise plus the next shadow step; focus as the 2px gold outline, 3px offset.
**Do** use logical properties for every inline-axis offset; mirror only arrows, the tie angle and select chevrons explicitly in RTL.
**Do** pack repeated items into a 12px clipped frame with 1px Seam gaps instead of spacing cards apart.
donts: **Don't** add a kicker, eyebrow or overline above a heading; the section head is a headline and a sub only.
**Don't** use a second dark band on a page, or any dark background other than Painted Band Green.
**Don't** fill areas with green or gold, gradient text, or tinted section backgrounds; the only tints are Green Wash under "us" cells and chips and Gold Wash for selection and focus.
**Don't** add glows, inset bevels, blur-backed cards or drop shadows on text; the header's backdrop blur is the single blur in the system.
**Don't** use raster imagery or screenshots; every figure is inline SVG or HTML built from the bar, tag and chip primitives.
**Don't** introduce a new entrance style, a second easing for entrances, or per-component scroll clocks.
**Don't** set body or lead copy heavier than 300, or strong text heavier than 600.
**Don't** exceed 12px radius on rectangles or round a bar end beyond 3px.
**Don't** place a painted end anywhere but the extreme of a bar.
